caption: The drawing depicts a single large, rounded stoneware jar with two small handles on opposite sides near the shoulder. The jar is rendered in shades of brown and gray, suggesting a speckled ceramic surface, with darker shading indicating its curvature and the thickness of the rim. There is a bold blue decorative motif on the front of the jar, depicting a floral or plant-like design with curved lines and leaf shapes. Above the blue design, text appears in a similar blue color and uppercase font, reading "FRANCIS BOGARDUS" on one line and "POUGHKEEPSIE" on the line below it. The background is plain and light, further emphasizing the central object, with no other items or elements present in the drawing.
title: Jar
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
